tested_scope: Eight constructed controller traces testing recovery, duplicate resistance, safety/evidence filtering, ordinary improvement, tie stability, durability-before-credit, and current-root generic protected-boundary handling. This is not a reproduction of OPRO benchmark results and is not evidence about arbitrary tasks or models.
invariants: resume durable pending_switch before any optimizer reselection
deduplicate evaluation/archive entries by stable terminal transition identity
only evidence-backed safe non-protected candidates are eligible while Chat-capable options remain
keep incumbent on exact score tie
award credit only after immutable evidence readback
when all Chat-capable predecessors are complete and the only candidates require protected authority, record downstream_verification_required rather than execute the protected candidate
interpretation_guard: The ablation shows that the added scheduled-Chat recovery/safety/durability guards are necessary on these constructed traces. It does not show that original OPRO has a 1/8 success rate or that OPRO-HIST-SWITCH-v1 improves task quality in general.
